English Literature and Grammar.question: ১) You will fail the exam if you _____ from school.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Take to  task- অর্থ তিরস্কার করা, put off- অর্থ খুলে ফেলা, put out- অর্থ নিভানো, play traunt- অর্থ পলায়ন করা।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২) Lyndra had to ..... eating apples after the orthodontist put braces on her teeth.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Had to এরপর verb এর base form বসে। একমাত্র quit ই হচ্ছে base form.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩) There is no alternative ____ training.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Appropriate preposition এর নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Alternative এরপর to  বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪) Find out the correct sentence
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) He Insisted on my going to cinema
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) He insisted me to go to cinema
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) He Insisted in my going to cinema
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) He Insisted for my going to cinema
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Insist অর্থ পীড়াপীড়ি বা জোর করা।  কাউকে কোনো কিছুর ওপর জোর দেয়া বা পীড়াপীড়ি করা অর্থে insist এর preposition হিসেবে on  বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫) The teacher will help the poor student ____?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: সাধারণত tag question- এ প্রথম অংশ পজেটিভ থাকলে দ্বিতীয় অংশ নেগেটিভ হয়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬) If you had started earlier, you ..... the train
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Third conditional:- Had + past perfect + would/could/might have + Vpp + extension.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭) If I were a bird......
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) I would Fly to you
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) I would have Fly to you
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) I will Fly to you
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Second conditional:- If + were + would/could/might + Verb- এর present.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮) The idiom 'A stitch in time saves nine'- refers to the importance of ______
English Literature and Grammar.exp: 'A stitch in time saves nine' একটি Idiom যার অর্থ- সময়ের একফোঁড় অসময়ের দশফোঁড়। অর্থাৎ সময়মতো কাজ করাকে নির্দেশ করে যা timely action এর সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯) What would be the right synonym for 'initiative'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Initiative -- উদ্যোগ
Indolence -- শ্রমবিমুখতা
Apathy -- অনীহা, ঔদার্য
Enterprise -- কর্মপ্রচেষ্টা

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১০) 'Frailty the name is woman'- is a famous dialogue from.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: ‘Frailty thy name is woman’ এটি William Shakespeare এর বিখ্যাত drama Hamlet থেকে নেওয়া। এই উক্তিটি Hamlet তার মাকে উদ্দেশ্য করে বলেছেন। This speech taken to mean that woman are weaker than men.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১১) The age of 'Neo-Classical Period' is _______.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Neo-Classical period (1660-1798)
Restoration Age (1660-1700)
Augustan Period/The Age of Pope (1700-1745)
Age of Sensibility (1745-1785/98)
The Romantic Period (1798-1832)
The Victorian Period (1832-1901)

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১২) A man is known..... the company he keeps.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Known by অর্থ পরিচিত হয়। এখানে বাক্যটির অর্থ দাঁড়ায় একজন মানুষকে তার সঙ্গী দ্বারা চেনা যায়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১৩) The poem 'Lucy' is written by-
English Literature and Grammar.exp: William Wordsworth (1770-1850) was an English Romantic poet. তাকে Poet of Nature, Poet of Childhood, and Lake poet বলা হয়। তার রচিত Poems:- The Solitary Reaper, The Daffodils, The Excursion, Michael, There Years She Grew, A Slumber, Did my Spirit Seal, I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud, The World is Too Much with Us, Recluse, Cuckoo, Lucy, Written in March, Tintern Abbey, Ode to Duty etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১৪) Who is not the poet of 'Romantic age'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Famous Victorian Writers: Lord Alfred Tennyson, Robert Browning, Matthew Arnold, Charles Dickens, Makxim Gorky, William Makepeace Thackeray, Thomas Hardy, Edgar Allan poe, Oscar Wilde Samuel Butler, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, Mark Twain, Cardinal Newman, Gladstone, Charlotte Bronte, Emily Bronte, Leo Tolstoy etc.
Famous Romantic writers:- William Wordsworth, ST Coleridge, PB Shelley, John Keats, William Blake, Charles lamb, Lord Byron, Jane Austen etc

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১৫) Who wrote the book 'The Ruins of Time'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Edmund Spencer is called The poet of poets. He wrote the book Amoretti, The Faerie Queen (epic), The Shepherd's Calendar, the Ruins of Time etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১৬) Who wrote the Short Story 'Debits and Credits'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Notable Works of Rudyard Kipling:-
Novels- Puck of Pook's Hill, Captain Courageous, The Jungle Book, Limits & Renewals, Just So Stories, Soldiers Three, The Light that Failed, Kim, Plain Tales from the Hills, Seven Seas, The White Man's Burden
Short story- Debits and Credits
Poem- The Fight, The Blue Roses etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১৭) The play 'You Never Can Tell' is written by-
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
George Bernard Shaw (1856-1950) একজন বিখ্যাত আইরিশ Playwright and a Critic। তিনি ১৯২৫ শালী ইংরেজি সাহিত্যে নোবেল পুরস্কার লাভ করেন। তাঁর উপাধি The greatest modem English dramatist এবং তাঁকে The father of modern English literature বলা হয়। তাঁর উল্লেখযোগ্য রচনা:- Candida, Caeser and Cleopatra, Man and Superman, Mrs. Warren's Profession, The Apple Cart, , Man and Superman, Arms and The Man, Caesar and Cleopatra, Doctor's Dilemma, St. Joan of Arc, You Never Can Tell, Major Barbara, Man of destiny, Pygmalion etc.
Androcles and The Lion ইত্যাদি।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১৮) Who wrote the Tragedy 'Doctor Faustus'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Christopher Marlowe is called Father of English Drama/Tragedy. He wrote the plays- Doctor Faustus, The Jew of Malta, The Massacre of Paris, Tambeurlaine the Great etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১৯) Who wrote the novel 'David Copperfield'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Famous novels by Charles Dickens:- Great Expectations, The Adventures of Oliver Twist, The old Curiosity Shop, David Copperfield, A Tale of Two Cities, The Pickwick Papers, A Christmas Carol, Hard Times, The Bleak House, Our Mutual Friend etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২০) Who wrote the novel 'The Old Man and the Sea'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Famous novels of Ernest Hemingway:
A Farewell to Arms, The Old Man and the Sea, For Whom the Bell Tolls, The Sun also Rises, The Dangerous Summer, True at First Light, The Torrents of Spring etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২১) Which is the latest period of English literature?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
The Victorian Period is (1832-1901)
-The Pre-Raphaelites (1848-1860)
-Aestheticism and Decadence (1880-1901)
The Modern Period is (1901-1939)
-The Edwardian Period (1901-10)
-The Georgian Period (1910-36)
The Post Modern Period (1939-Present)

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২২) Who is called the Father of English Modern Poetry?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Geoffrey Chaucer is called Morning Star of Renaissance, The First Great Modernist, Father of English Language, Father of English Literature, Father of English Modern Poetry, etc. He is the Representative Poet of Fourteenth century.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২৩) What kind of noun is 'Committee'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Army, Council, Audience, Department, Minority, Crowd, Family, Senate, Society, Committee, Group, Team, Cattle, Pack, Company, Jury, Corporation, Majority, Police, Gang, Navy, Library, Class, Public, Infantry, Orchestra etc. are collective noun.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২৪) Could  you tell me .....?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Could  you tell me what time it is? এর অর্থ এখন কয়টা বাজে আপনি কি আমাকে বলতে পারেন।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২৫) Who wrote the book 'Hamlet'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Famous tragedy of William Shakespeare:
Macbeth, Hamlet, Othello, King Lear, Julius Caesar, Titus Andronicus, Troilus and Cressida, Romeo and Juliet, Coriolanus, Antony and Cleopatra, Cymbeline, Timon of Athens.
Famous comedy of William Shakespeare:
As you like it, All's well that ends well, A Mid Summer Night Dreams, The Tempest, Twelfth night, The taming of the Shrew, Two gentlemen of Verona, The Merchant of Venice, Much Ado About Nothing, Merry wives of Windsor, Measure for Measure, Comedy of errors, Love's Labour's Lost.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২৬) Give the correct passive form of 'His conduct annoyed me'.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) I was annoyed with his conduct
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) I was annoyed from his conduct
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) I was annoyed at his conduct
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) I was annoyed to his conduct
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Active voice কে Passive voice- এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম: Active Voice এর object‌ টি Passive voice এর subject হয় + Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb + মূল verb এর past participle + Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এর object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to ,in) বসে। আর কোন ব্যক্তির উপর বিরক্ত বোঝাতে annoyed with কিন্তু বস্তু বা কাজের উপর বিরক্ত বোঝাতে annoyed at বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২৭) What kind of noun is 'Mutton'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Silver, Iron, Cotton, Diamond, Milk, Paint, Rubber, Paper, Steel, Sand, Wood, Mutton, Sugar, Oil etc. are material noun.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২৮) 'The Merchant of Venice' is a Shakespearean play about_______
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Jew (ইহুদি) গ্রন্থটির কাহিনী এ রকম -- ষোল শতকের দিকে তৎকালীন ভেনিস শহরে এক সম্ভ্রান্ত ব্যক্তি ছিল যার নাম ছিল Shylock । যিনি লোকদেরকে ঋণ প্রদান করতেন। একদাএক ইহুদী বণিক তার কাছে কঠিন শর্ত সাপেক্ষে ঋণ গ্রহণ করে।  শর্ত ছিল টাকা পরিশোধে ব্যর্থ হলে তার শরীরের দুই কেজি মাংস কেটে নেওয়া হবে।  কথামতো টাকা শোধ করতে ব্যর্থ হওয়ায় শর্তপূরণের উপক্রম হলে এক বিচারক তাকে রক্ষা করে এই যুক্তিতে যে মাংস কাটা হবে তবে রক্তপাত যেন না হয়। কারণ শর্তে রক্তের কথা উল্লেখ ছিল না।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ২৯) The word 'Friendly' is _______.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Noun+ly=adjective
Example: Friendly, Homely, Brotherly, Motherly, Sisterly, Manly, Kingly, Frankly, Cowardly etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩০) Which one is Adjective?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
সাধারণত Noun এর শেষে Y থাকে। যেমন: Honesty, Beauty, Charity, Gravity etc. কিন্তু কিছু কিছু Noun এর পর Y যোগ করলে তারা Adjective হয়ে যায়। অর্থাৎ Noun + Y = Adjective
Noun ______ Adjective
Ice___________Icy
Mud__________Muddy
Oil____________Oily
Home_________Homey
Blood__________Bloody etc.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩১) What is the noun form of 'Accept'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Here noun form of accept is acceptance.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩২) 'The programme was telecast live'. The word 'live' in the above sentence is a/an ____.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
প্রদত্ত বাক্যে live (সরাসরি) adverb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে কেননা এটি verb কে modify করছে।
প্রদত্ত বাক্যের অর্থ :- অনুষ্ঠানটি সরাসরি সম্প্রচারিত হলো।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩৩) Choose the incorrect sentence.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) Who is the best among these boys?
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) Who is the best among the three boys?
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) Who is the best boy of this group?
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) Who is the best of the two boys?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Of the two থাকলে the + comparative হয়। তাই the best না হয় the better হবে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩৪) Choose the correct sentence.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) Ten miles are a long distance.
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) Ten miles make a long distance.
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) Ten miles are more long distance.
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) Ten miles is a long distance.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Distance- এর একক plural হলেও verb singular হয় তাই Ten miles is হবে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩৫) While going to class________.
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) I was bitten by a dog
English Literature and Grammar.exp: ক্লাসে যাওয়ার সময় 'ব্যক্তি' কুকুরের কামড়ে আক্রান্ত হয়েছে তাই সঠিক উত্তর হবে ঘ ।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩৬) Which one is the verb of the word 'Real'
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Real এর সাথে suffix 'ise/ize' add করলে তা verb এ রূপান্তরিত হয়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩৭) I know that he has passed. Here 'that he has passed' is a/an _____ clause.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Dependent clause টিকে it দ্বারা replace করা গেলে যদি অর্থবোধক বাক্য তৈরি হয় তাহলে সেটি  noun clause হয়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩৮) The passive form of 'Don't waste your time' is ______.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) Let you time be not wasted
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) Let you time not be waste
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) Let your time be wasted
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) Let not your time be wasted
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Let not + object + be + vpp.
Here the passive form of 'Don't waste your time' is Let not your time be wasted.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৩৯) Qualifying in the admission test is not easy. Here, 'Qualifying in the admission test' is a/an _________ phrase.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: দুই বা ততোধিক শব্দ যদি subject- এর অবস্থানে বসে তাহলে সেই শব্দগুচ্ছ noun- এর কাজ করবে। আর সেটি হবে noun phrase। Phrase/clause টিকে it দ্বারা replace করা গেলে যদি অর্থবোধক বাক্য তৈরি হয় তাহলে সেটি  noun phrase/clause হয়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪০) The word 'In a nutshell' means ____
English Literature and Grammar.exp: In a nutshell অর্থ সংক্ষেপে (briefly)

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪১) Toni Morrison died in _______.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Famous novels by Toni Morrison:
Beloved, Song of Solomon, The Bluest Eye (got Nobel prize in 1993), Sula. Toni Morrison died in 2019.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪২) Who wrote the novel 'The White Peacock'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
D H Lawrence well known novels:
The White Peacock, The Rainbow, Women in Love, A Modern Lover, Lady Chatterley's Lover.
Sons and Lovers' is an autobiographical Novel.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪৩) Which is the verb of the word 'Life'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Here, Lively /Living is adjective. Live is verb or adverb and Life is noun.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪৪) Had he known anything, he ____________ told me.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Conditional sentence- এ Had + Sub + V3 + Ext. এভাবে কোন Sentence শুরু হলে সেটিও Perfect conditional/ 3rd conditional হয়।
if clause- এ যদি (had + V3) হয়, তবে পরবর্তী clause- এ would/could/might + have + V3 + extension. ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪৫) Who wrote the Novel 'Nineteen Eighty Four'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
George Orwell's well known novels:- Homage to Catalonia, Nineteen Eighty Four, Animal farm, Burmese Days, A Clergyman Daughter, coming up for Airs etc.
Shooting An Elephant is a famous short story by George Orwell.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪৬) I saw a walking boy. Here 'walking' is -------.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: -verb + adjective এর কাজ করে তাহলে participle হবে। ing যুক্ত word এর বাক্যের অর্থ দ্বারা যদি চলমান কিছু বুঝায় তাহলে হবে participle। I saw a walking boy. ( verb + adj )। boy noun . আর noun কে adjective modified করে । অর্থঃ আমি একটি বালক হাটতে দেখেছি। অর্থ চলমান বুঝাচ্ছে তাই participle হবে। It is breaking news। চলমান বুঝাচ্ছে তাই participle. A rolling stone gathers no moss . অর্থঃ ঘূর্ণায়মান পাথরে শেওলা জন্মে না। পাথরটি ঘুরছে । মানে চলমান তাই participle.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪৭) Which one is Plural Noun?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Abuse, Athletics, Bread, Darts, Economics, Ethics, Expenditure, Furniture, Machinery, Mathematics, News, Optics, Physics, Poetry, Politics, Scenery, Gallows etc. noun always singular noun.
Wages, Aristocracy, Artillery, Cattle, People, Peasantry, Public, Vegetables etc. are always plural noun.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪৮) 'In black and white' means-
English Literature and Grammar.exp: 'In black and white' phrase টির বাংলা 'লিখিতভাবে' অর্থাৎ In writing.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৪৯) Which spelling is correct?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Renaissance ----- নবজাগরণ

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫০) Who wrote the poem 'The Daffodils'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
To Daffodils --- Robert Herrick
The Daffodils --- William Wordsworth
Daffodils ------ Ted Hughes

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫১) Walking is good for health. Here 'Walking' is--
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
-verb + noun এর কাজ করে তাহলে gerund হবে ।
-বাক্য যদি চলমান না বুঝায় তাহলে হবে gerund .
-Example : walking is good for health .
( verb + noun ) Explain : is হল verb । আর verb এর আগে সাধারণত noun / pronoun বসে । অর্থঃ হাটা স্বাস্থের জন্য ভাল। এই বুঝাচ্ছে না যে এখন কেউ হাটছে । তাই gerund হবে। I like swimming অর্থঃ আমি সাতার পছন্দ করি । চলমান না তাই gerund, This is my reading room . অর্থঃ এই হল আমার পড়ার কক্ষ। চলমান বুঝাচ্ছে না , তাই gerund হবে।
A walking street . অর্থঃ একটি হাটার রাস্তা। চলমান নয় তাই gerund.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫২) What would be the antonym of 'Hibernate'
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Hibernate অর্থ-বিচেতন অবস্থায় কাটানাে বা শীতনিদ্রা যাওয়া,  Democracy অর্থ সুপ্তাবস্থা, Sluggishness অর্থ- নিষ্ক্রিয়তা, Liveliness অর্থ উচ্ছলতা বা প্রাণবন্ততা, Democracy অর্থ- গণতন্ত্র।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫৩) I know the boy who went there. Here 'who went there' is a/an _____ clause.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Relative pronoun এর পূর্বে antecedent থাকলে উক্ত relative pronoun যুক্ত অংশকে Adjective Clause বলা হয়। যেমন: I know the man (antecedent) who loves me (adjective clause).
The man who works hard succeed finally.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫৪) 'Call to mind' means -
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Fantasize- কল্পনা, Attend- মনােযােগ দেয়া; Request- অনুরােধ, remember- মনে রাখা বা স্মরণ করা।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫৫) ________ is not the only thing that tourists want to see.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Scenery -- uncountable noun তাই শুধু Scenery হবে। সাধারণত uncountable noun -- Singular. এদের পূর্বে সাধারণত Article বা সংখ্যাবাচক শব্দ বসেনা। এদের সাথে সাধারণত s/es যোগ করা যায় না।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫৬) Who wrote the play 'The Garden Party'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
T.S. Eliot --------- The Cocktail Party
K. Mansfield ---- The Garden Party
Harold Pinter ---The Birthday Party

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫৭) 'Pass away' means-
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Pass away (phrase)-মারা যাওয়া, Disappear- অদৃশ্য হওয়া, Fall-পতিত হওয়া, Erase- মুছে ফেলা।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫৮) Synonym for 'Extempore'
English Literature and Grammar.exp: 'Extempore' যার অর্থ পূর্বচিন্তা বা পূর্বপ্রস্তুতি ছাড়া এর সমার্থক শব্দ জানতে চাওয়া হয়েছে। Option গুলােতে প্রদত্ত Word সমূহের meaning যেমন: Planned- পরিকল্পিত, Improvise- ছড়া বলা, আশু রচনা করা, Impromptu- প্রত্যুৎপন্ন বা উপস্থিত মত, Immediate- আসন্ন।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৫৯) What is the Masculine form of 'Hind'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Masculine - Feminine
Drone- Bee
Stag - Hind
Hart - Roe

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬০) Synonym for 'Menacing'
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Menacing যার অর্থ 'ভীতিকর বা বিপজ্জনক' এর সমার্থক শব্দ জানতে চাওয়া হয়েছে৷ Option গুলােতে প্রদত্ত Word সমূহের meaning যেমন: Encouraging- উৎসাহব্যঞ্জক, Alarming- উদ্বেগজনক বা বিপজ্জনক,
Promising- প্রতিশ্রুতিপর্ণ, Auspicious- শুভ বা মঙ্গলিক।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬১) The number of girls ________ present today's program.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
The Number of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb.
এখানে The Number of আছে তাই Singular Verb‌ হবে is এবং Plural Noun হবে girls.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬২) Antonym for 'Cynical'
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Cynical যার অর্থ 'নৈরাশ্যবাদী আচরণসম্পন্ন বা সন্দেহজনক' এর বিপরীতার্থক শব্দ জানতে চাওয়া হয়েছে। option গুলােতে প্রদও Word সমূহের meaning যেমন: Pessimistic- হতাশাপ্রবণ, Gullible - সহজে প্রতারণাযোগ্য, Equivocal-সন্দেহজনক,  Liberal- উদার বা মুক্ত।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬৩) It's time you______your mistakes.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: It is time- এরপর pronoun- এর subjective form আসলে সেই subjective এরপর verb- এর past form ব্যবহৃত হয়। সুতরাং শূন্যস্থানে realize-এর past form realized বসবে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬৪) Synonym for 'Sporadic'
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Sporadic যার অর্থ বিক্ষিপ্তভাবে ঘটিত, ছড়ানাে ছিটানাে এর সমার্থক শব্দ জানতে চাওয়া হয়েছে। Option গুলােতে প্রদও Word সমূহের meaning যেমন: Consistent- সঙ্গতিপূর্ণ, Uniform- একই রকম
Frequent- প্রায়শই সংঘটিত হয় এমন, বার বার ; Scattered- বিক্ষিপ্ত, ছড়িয়ে ছিটিয়ে পড়া।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬৫) The boy excels _____ speaking English.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Persist in - লেগে থাকা
Excel in - গুণে বা কৃতিত্বে শ্রেষ্ঠ হওয়া।
Indulge in - আসক্ত হওয়া

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬৬) Milton ________ the book before he retired.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Past perfect + before + past indefinite

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬৭) The man died _____ malaria.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: রোগে মারা যাওয়া অর্থে die of বসে‌।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬৮) The sun has gone down. Here 'down' is a/an _____.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: বাক্যের শেষে Preposition Adverb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৬৯) Which word is the determiner in the sentence, 'Will it take much time'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Much, many, few, little, a, an, the, less, all etc are determiner.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭০) Neither the players nor the trainer ________ in the room.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: But, or, nor দ্বারা দুটি Noun/Pronoun যুক্ত হলে নিকটবর্তী Noun/Pronoun এর উপর ভিত্তি করে verb বসে। অর্থাৎ পরবর্তী subject অনুসারে verb বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭১) The English ____ a polite nation.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
The + Nation (জাতি) + plural verb
Language (ভাষা) + singular verb

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭২) Ten students love _____________.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: সাধারণত দুজনের মধ্যে পারস্পরিক সম্পর্ক বুঝাতে each other এবং দুয়ের অধিক ব্যক্তির মধ্যে পারস্পরিক সম্পর্ক বোঝাতে one another ব্যবহৃত হয়। one another/each other সাধারণত বাক্যের শেষে বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭৩) He has been ill _______ three months.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: For- preposition টি period of time অর্থাৎ অনির্দিষ্ট সময় বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত হয়। অন্যদিকে since- preposition টি point of time অর্থাৎ নির্দিষ্ট সময় বোঝাতে ব্যবহৃত হয়‌।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭৪) It is time (do) the work.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: It is time , it is high time ইত্যাদির পর Subject থাকলে Verb - টি Past Tense এর হয় । আর এদের পর subject না থাকলে to + Verb হয় । যেমন It is high time we discussed the matter, It is time to do the work.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭৫) Rishan walks as if he __________ a lame.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: বাক্যে as if , as though , wish এর পর to be verb আসলে তা সব সময় were হবে । অন্য কোনাে Verb আসলে তার Past tense হয় । যেমনঃ Rishan walks as if he were a lame .

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭৬) She is looking forward _______ Europe.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: বাক্যে mind , cannot help, could not help , with a view to, look forward to, be used to, get used to, worth ইত্যাদির পর কোনাে Verb আসলে উক্ত Verb - এর সাথে ing যুক্ত হয় । যেমনঃ She is looking forward to going Europe. Would you mind closing the door.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭৭) He ran fast lest he __________ the train.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Lest- দ্বারা দুটি বাক্যাংশ যুক্ত হলে Lest যুক্ত অংশের Subject এর পর should হয় এবং মূল Verb এর Present form বসে ।
যেমনঃ He ran fast lest he should miss the train.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭৮) Choose the incorrect sentence.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) No sooner had we reached the station than the train left
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) Scarcely had we started when it began to rain.
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) Hardly had the train stopped before we got down
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) Scarcely we had started when it began to rain.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Negative word + Auxiliary verb + Subject + main verb + extension.
No sooner had - than , scarcely had – when , hardly had – before এর প্রথম অংশ Past Perfect and Verb এর Past Participle হয় এবং ২য় অংশে Past Indefinite হয় । উল্লেখ্য, no sooner.......than, scarcely......when , hardly........ when আসে - এ বিষয়টি মাথায় রাখতে হবে । যেমনঃ No sooner had we reached the station than the train left, Hardly had the train stopped before we got down, Scarcely had we started when it began to rain.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৭৯) Choose the correct sentence.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) The main that said that was a fool.
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) The man who said that was a fool
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) The man, that said that, was a fool.
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) The man which said that was a fool.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Person + who + verb.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮০) The man was absent ________ the meeting.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Absent from- অনুপস্থিত।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮১) She was oblivious _____ her surroundings.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Oblivious of - মনভোলা বা অচেতন‌

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮২) Choose the correct sentence.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) She had faith and hopes for future.
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) She had faith and hopes in the future.
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) She had faith and hopes for the future.
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) She had faith in and hopes for the future.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Appropriate preposition - faith in.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮৩) Choose the correct sentence.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) The train is running in time.
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) The train is running with time.
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) The train is running on time.
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) The train is running to time.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বে বোঝাতে in time বসে। আর নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের পূর্বেও না পরেও না অর্থাৎ ঠিক সময় বোঝাতে on time বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮৪) The paper is made ______ wood.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: কোন কিছু তৈরীর পর ঐ উপাদানটি দেখা না গেলে made from বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮৫) I am writing the essay _____ blue ink.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: কালিতে লেখা বুঝাতে In ink বসে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮৬) How many eggs have your hens _____ this month?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: ডিম দেওয়া lay - laid - laid অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮৭) Many boys _______ done the job.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Many+Plural Noun+Plural verb.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮৮) He is _____ heir of the property.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Heir এর উচ্চারণ 'এআর' তাই an হবে।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৮৯) The cattle _____ grazing in the field.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: The cattle (গবাদি পশু) শব্দটির পর plural verb বসে। তাই, are and were দুটোই সঠিক। অপশন দুইটা সঠিক তাই বাতিল করা হল।

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯০) Identify the correct sentence.
English Literature and Grammar.option1: ক) One and a half hour is a long time.
English Literature and Grammar.option2: খ) One and a half hours is a long time.
English Literature and Grammar.option3: গ) One and a half hour are a long time.
English Literature and Grammar.option4: ঘ) One and  half hours is a long time.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: One and a half + plural noun + singular verb.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯১) Who wrote the play 'Volpone'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Ben Jonson is called father of comedy of humours. Famous plays of Ben jonson-- Every Man in his Humour, Every Man Out of his Humour, the Silent Woman, The Alchemist, Volpone.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯২) William Shakespeare was born in ________.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: William Shakespeare was the National poet of England. He was born in 1564 and died in 1616. He is called King without crown, the bard of Avon, the greatest superstar of the world, the greatest dramatist.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯৩) 'As You Like It' is a famous ____ by William Shakespeare.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: As you like it, All's well that ends well, A Mid-Summer Night Dreams, The Tempest, Twelfth Night, The taming of the Shrew, Two gentlemen of Verona, The Merchant of Venice, Much Ado About Nothing, Merry wives of Windsor, Measure for Measure, Comedy of Errors, Love's Labor’s Lost.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯৪) 'Paradise Lost' is a/an ____ by John Milton.
English Literature and Grammar.exp: John Milton known as Epic poet. His famous Epic - Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯৫) Who wrote the epic 'The Rape of the Lock'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Alexander Pope is known as 'Mock Heroic Poet'. His famous epic is The Rape of the Lock.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯৬) Who wrote the poem 'The Waste Land'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: The Waste Land, The Hollow Men, Ash Wednesday, Four Quartets etc are famous poem by T. S. Eliot. Murder in the Cathedral, The Cocktail Party, The Trail of a Judge etc are the famous plays by T. S. Eliot.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯৭) 'But I have promises to keep, And miles to go before I sleep' is taken from the poem of _____.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Famous Quotation by Robert Frost is
'But I have promises to keep
And miles to go before I sleep, (Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening).

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯৮) Wrote the Novel 'Seize the Day'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: Saul Bellow is an American famous novelist. Seize the Day, the Adventure of Arabic March are the famous novel by Saul Bellow.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ৯৯) Who wrote the Short story 'The Gift of the Magi'?
English Literature and Grammar.exp: His Famous short story: The Gift of the Magi, Sixes and Sevens, Roads of Destiny, Cabbage and Kings, The Four million, The Voice of the City, The Ransom of The Red Chief, Hearts and Hands, Heart of the West.

English Literature and Grammar.question: ১০০) 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty' is taken from the writings of ____.
English Literature and Grammar.exp:
Famous qoutes of Keats:
- Beauty is truth, truth beauty.
- A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
- Heard melodies are sweet but those unheard are sweeter.
